programme.desc: Les destins de Squeezie, Angèle et Kendji Girac, révélés par le web, la musique et le talent.

programme.title: Quelqu'un Que J'ai Bien Connu
programme.desc: Lors d'un voyage dans sa ville natale, Ally (Alison Brie), une bourreau de travail, passe une nuit tourbillonnante avec son ex-petit ami Sean (Jay Ellis), ce qui l'amène à remettre en question tous les choix qu'elle a faits et la personne qu'elle est devenue.

programme.title: Ne serait-ce que
programme.desc: Une tragédie apprend au jeune homme d'affaires anglais Ian Wyndham à faire passer l'amour avant le travail. Il apprend enfin à s'ouvrir à sa petite amie Samantha Andrews.

programme.title: Le merveilleux jardin secret de Bella Brown
programme.desc: Bella, jeune femme fantasque, risque l'expulsion si elle ne remet pas son jardin en état. Elle fait alors la rencontre d'Alfie, son voisin bougon et passionné de jardinage, qui va bouleverser sa vie.

programme.title: Tous les chemins mènent à Rome
programme.desc: Une mère de famille un peu à cran, se voit partir en road trip en Italie avec son amour de jeunesse Italien, afin de rattraper sa fille rebelle, qui souhaite rejoindre New-York à tout prix.

programme.title: Lucky girl
programme.desc: Ashley est la femme la plus chanceuse de New York. Mais sa chance s'intervertit bizarrement avec celle du jeune homme le plus malchanceux de la ville.

programme.title: Vengeance du passé
programme.desc: Une femme retourne chez elle pour enquêter sur la mort mystérieuse de ses amis d'enfance.

programme.title: La Nouvelle Locataire
programme.desc: Lorsque son mari est hospitalisé à la suite d'un accident de voiture, Karen, ambulancière, décide de louer leur chambre d'amis en ligne. Tout se passe bien jusqu'à ce que Miranda emménage. Miranda s'infiltre rapidement dans tous les domaines de la vie de Karen. Lorsqu'un des locataires de Karen est retrouvé assassiné, Karen est convaincue que Miranda est impliquée, mais ne se doute pas qu'en mettant son invité psychotique à la porte, Miranda va entrer dans une rage meurtrière.

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Le Dr. Marissa Blumenthal enquête sur la propagation d'un terrible virus qui s'abat sur Los Angeles. La jeune femme est persuadée que l'épidémie est le fruit d'un acte criminel.

programme.title: Un Anglais à New York
programme.desc: Sidney Young est un intellectuel désabusé qui adore autant qu'il méprise le monde des célébrités, de la gloire et du glamour. Son magazine alternatif, Post Modern Review , se moque des stars obsédées par les médias et va à contre-courant des tendances. Lorsqu'on lui propose un poste dans le très conservateur magazine new-yorkais Sharps , c'est un véritable choc ! Il semble que Clayton Harding, le rédacteur en chef de Sharps , ait été amusé par la perturbation d'une soirée post-BAFTA par Young, accompagné d'un cochon déguisé en Babe. Commence alors la descente de Sidney vers le succès : il passe progressivement du statut d'outsider moqué à celui de confident de la starlette Sophie Maes. Au début, il est aidé chez Sharps par sa collègue Alison Olsen, qui cache elle aussi un secret. Leur amitié y survivra-t-elle ?

programme.title: The Cake Eaters: Absolution in Love
programme.desc: Deux familles se retrouvent à l'occasion du retour de l'un des fils.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Let it Snow
programme.desc: Par un grand jour de neige, James rencontre Sarah. Des années plus tard, les deux se retrouvent à New York.

programme.title: Le Casse-Coeur
programme.desc: En plein cambriolage dans une maison, harry rencontre daisy et décide de la sauver d'elle-même.

programme.title: The Cake Eaters: Absolution in Love
programme.desc: Deux familles se retrouvent à l'occasion du retour de l'un des fils.

programme.title: Let it Snow
programme.desc: Par un grand jour de neige, James rencontre Sarah. Des années plus tard, les deux se retrouvent à New York.

programme.title: Potins De Femmes
programme.desc: Dans la ville imaginaire de Chinquapin, en Louisiane, un mariage se prépare. La mariée s'appelle Shelby (Julia Roberts), une belle jeune femme têtue dont la mère très stricte, M'Lynn (Sally Field), est prête à tout pour elle. Dolly Parton à la chevelure imposante joue le rôle de Truvy, la propriétaire d'un salon de beauté qui est le centre non officiel de la ville. Parmi sa clientèle jamais en reste de potins, il y a Ouiser (Shirley MacLaine), la femme la plus riche et la plus méchante du coin, et Clairee (Olympia Dukakis), une élégante veuve plutôt sournoise. L'atmosphère s'anime avec l'arrivée d'une nouvelle jeune femme, Annelle (Daryl Hannah), une stagiaire un peu naïve avec ses lunettes de chat et son passé mystérieux. Ces six « magnolias de fer » forment un groupe de soutien et d'amitié et constituent un bon auditoire pour les blagues des unes et des autres malgré les aléas de l'existence et de l'amour dans une petite ville du sud.

programme.title: Still Crazy
programme.desc: Wisbech 1977. Strange Fruit, le groupe de rock britannique, jette ses derniers feux. Entre les chamailleries mesquines et les coups bas en coulisses et sur scene, le groupe se dissout. Ibiza 1997. Tony, l'ancien clavier, reconverti en fournisseur de preservatifs sur l'ile, rencontre par hasard le fils du promoteur de Wisbech qui lui propose de reformer le groupe pour un concert, Wisbech 1998.

programme.title: Miss Campus
programme.desc: Arrivée dans l'université de South Atlantic, Sydney White ne que rentrer dans la prestigieuse confrérie féminine fondée par sa défunte mère. Mais elle découvre que ce club a évolué pour le pire sous la férule de la narcissique et cruelle Rachel. Dégoûtée de cet avilissement elle quitte la fraternité, mais se retrouve du même coup à la rue. Elle trouve alors refuge dans la maison d'un groupe de septs exclus de sa faculté, avec lesquels elle va ourdir un plan pour briser la mainmise de Rachel sur le campus et redonner leur dignité aux laissés-pour-compte du campus. Une version moderne et décalée de Blanche-Neige et les sept nains.

programme.title: Premiers Pas Dans La Mafia
programme.desc: A peine arrivé à New York, Clark Kellogg, jeune étudiant en cinéma, se fait détrousser par un faux chauffeur de taxi. Mais cet incident l'amène à rencontrer Carmine Sabatini, mafieux sosie du Parrain, qui lui confie une mission insolite : transporter un mystérieux colis destiné à une assemblée secrète de gourmets...

programme.title: 5 fantômes en terminale
programme.desc: On ne peut pas vraiment dire que Modesto fait figure de modèle de sociabilité. Même à l'époque des boums, le garçon avait déjà tendance à rester dans son coin. Autant dire que les choses ne se sont pas arrangées depuis qu'il s'est découvert une faculté pour voir et communiquer avec les fantômes.

programme.title: Mon beauf, ma sœur et moi
programme.desc: Patrick a toujours eu une relation agressive avec sa petite sœur Marilyn. Mais quand elle ramène à la maison son fiancé star de la télé, Ryan, la guerre est déclarée dans ce film désopilant et cauchemardesque sur une famille qui s'aime à en tuer.

programme.title: Big movie
programme.desc: La parodie ultime des plus grands blockbusters, de X-Men à Pirates des Caraïbes en passant par le Monde de Narnia et Harry Potter.

programme.title: Les amis à vendre
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, louer des amis est devenue une habitude courante chez les nantis, leur épargnant bien des déceptions affectives. Quand Jacques et Odile tombent sur les Begond, à un prix intéressant, ils savent faire l'affaire qui les rendra plus brillants aux yeux de leurs relations…

programme.title: Little Manhattan
programme.desc: Dans une ville connue pour son effervescence, deux jeunes amis sont sur le point de se lancer dans la plus grande des aventures. Gabe et Rosemary se connaissent depuis presque toujours, mais lorsqu'ils se retrouvent face à face lors d'un cours de karaté, ils se voient sous un jour nouveau.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Un capitaine de cavalerie a beaucoup de mal à maintenir la paix entre son colonel tyrannique et un chef indien déterminé à se venger.

programme.title: Texas
programme.desc: A Dallas, un ancien soldat de l'Union tente de démasquer une conspiration de Sudistes qui ont assassiné son père, son ami et le Président.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: Les cavaliers du destin
programme.desc: Le méchant Kincaid contrôle l'approvisionnement local en eau et prévoit de se débarrasser des autres éleveurs. L'agent gouvernemental Saunders se présente sous couverture pour se débarrasser de Kincaid et gagner le cœur d'une de ses victimes, Fay Denton.

programme.title: Two Eyes Staring
programme.desc: Paul, Christine et leur petite fille de 9 ans, Lisa, forment une famille ordinaire. Ils héritent d'une effrayante demeure laissée par la mère de Christine avec laquelle ils n'avaient plus de relations. Peu de temps après avoir emménagé, Lisa a d'étranges visions et se rend compte que sa sinistre nouvelle amie n'est autre que le fantôme de la jumelle morte de sa maman. Le père de Lisa finit lui aussi par suspecter sa femme de cacher un horrible secret, ce qui aura des conséquences mortelles….

programme.title: Soeurs de Glace
programme.desc: L'existence de Luke et Roger, deux étudiants du campus de St. John au Canada, va être bouleversée par l'arrivée de deux ravissantes créatures. Rapidement Luke, va trouver que les jeunes femmes ont un comportement étrange. La mort d'un étudiant retrouvé congelé va accentuer les soupçons du jeune homme quant à la véritable identité de ces nouvelles étudiantes.

programme.title: Heartless
programme.desc: Jamie Morgan, un jeune homme portant une grande tache de naissance en forme de cœur sur le visage, découvre qu'il y a des démons dans les rues de l'est de Londres.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln Contre Les Zombies
programme.desc: Durant la guerre civile, Abraham Lincoln apprend qu'une menace pèse sur l'avenir des États-Unis. Une armée de morts-vivants sudistes erre sur la surface du continent. En passant derrière les lignes ennemies, le Président se donne pour mission de détruire les zombies...

programme.title: T.I.M.
programme.desc: Abi, jeune ingénieure, s'installe à la campagne avec son mari pour travailler sur le dernier produit de sa société, une intelligence artificelle humanoïde appelée TIM. Programmé pour ne servir qu'elle, TIM développe peu à peu une obsession pour Abi, et semble déterminé à remplacer Paul, son mari.

programme.title: Alien Invasion : L'Éveil du Phénix
programme.desc: Une pluie d'astéroïdes frappe une station spatiale, puis atterrit dans une zone reculée du Grand Canyon. Des capsules mystérieuses se forment et mutent rapidement en créatures menaçant la station spatiale et la Terre.

programme.title: Project : Affinity
programme.desc: Un ancien Navy SEAL souffrant de stress post-traumatique sauve une femme puis en tombe amoureux, avant de la perdre aux mains de mystérieux ravisseurs.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: L'astronaute Roy McBride s'aventure jusqu'aux confins du système solaire à la recherche de son père disparu et pour résoudre un mystère qui menace la survie de notre planète.

programme.title: Iron Arm
programme.desc: Lors de sa première mission de nuit, une urgentiste et son partenaire sont amenés à soigner un super-héros chargé de sauver Los Angeles de la destruction.

programme.title: Le Pacte Du Mal
programme.desc: Diego, médecin endurci face à la douleur, est tenu pour responsable après la tentative de suicide de sa patiente Sara.

programme.title: Year 10
programme.desc: Dans un monde dévasté, Jake affronte la barbarie pour sauver celle qu'il aime.

programme.title: The Last Redemption
programme.desc: Dans un royaume dévasté, Diana, une hors-la-loi, défie le tyrannique Lord Roland pour sauver une princesse.

programme.title: Présentation du film Le Roi Arthur
programme.desc: Présentation du film Le Roi Arthur

programme.title: Le Roi Arthur : Le Pouvoir d'Excalibur
programme.desc: Le roi Arthur mourant confie Excalibur à un chevalier loyal, tandis que ses fils s'affrontent.

programme.title: Piégés dans la savane
programme.desc: Après un crash d'avion dans le désert du Kalahari un jeune couple doit survivre.

programme.title: Closer To God
programme.desc: Le généticien Victor Reed crée un clone humain, suscitant une vive controverse.

programme.title: Les Dieux des Profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une équipe de sous-marins entre dans une ouverture mystérieuse au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent un ancien peuple venu d'un autre monde.

programme.title: Shark Warning
programme.desc: Vingt ans après, un homme revient dans la ville où son frère a été tué par un requin. Bientôt le prédateur refait surface et tue à nouveau, l'homme décide de le traquer pour l'arrêter une fois pour toutes.

programme.title: Sputnik : Espèce Inconnue
programme.desc: Un cosmonaute revient sur Terre… avec quelque chose en lui.

programme.title: Charlie Says
programme.desc: La tragique histoire d'une jeune fille américaine transformée en tueuse sans pitié durant l'été 1969.

programme.title: Big Divorce
programme.desc: Fraîchement fiancé à Dylan, Michael se met en tête de retrouver son amour de jeunesse, Alex.

programme.title: Mon mari assassiné
programme.desc: Samson espionne sa voisine qui a une liaison et après le meurtre de son mari, il devient suspect.

programme.title: Hollywood Mistress
programme.desc: Scénaristes et producteurs luttent contre les caprices des financiers de leur film.

programme.title: Rogue agent
programme.desc: Focus sur le parcours Robert Hendy-Freegard. Cet ancien barman s'est fait passer pendant près de dix ans pour un agent des services secrets britanniques. Il parvenait à convaincre ses victimes qu'elles étaient les proies de terroristes de l'IRA.

programme.title: November Criminals
programme.desc: Deux amis bientôt étudiants universitaires (Ansel Elgort et Chloë Grace Moretz) tombent amoureux l'un de l'autre. Mais après le meurtre mystérieux de leur camarade de classe, ils défient les autorités de découvrir la vérité.

programme.title: OVNI: Sur la piste extraterrestre
programme.desc: Derek (Alex Sharp), un étudiant d'université brillant hanté par la vue d'un OVNI durant son enfance, croit que les mystérieuses observations signalées dans de nombreux aéroports des États-Unis sont des OVNIS...

programme.title: Intrusion (2015)
programme.desc: Francis Watts, "Franny", est riche, beau et célibataire. Alors où est le problème ? Le problème, c'est qu'il a 60 ans et qu'il n'a pas accompli grand-chose. Dans un effort désespéré pour recommencer une nouvelle vie, ce philanthrope drogué aux pilules va s'immiscer dans la vie d'un jeune couple.

programme.title: Ennemis rapprochés
programme.desc: Après un affrontement avec la police britannique, Frankie McGuire, membre de l'IRA, doit quitter l'Irlande pour les États-Unis. Il se cache dans une famille d'origine irlandaise, les O'Meary, dont le père, gagne sa vie en tant que policier.

programme.title: Almost Perfect
programme.desc: Une célèbre vlogueuse mère-fille se retrouve menacée par une de ses fangirl…

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Un rite d'initiation d'une fraternité universitaire tourne mal.

programme.title: En ce moment sur Box Office Action
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Les visions d'un architecte atteint d'une maladie oculaire deviennent intolérables.

programme.title: La Prophétie des ombres
programme.desc: Un reporter est dans une petite ville de Virginie pour enquêter sur une série d'événements étranges.

programme.title: Killing Salazar
programme.desc: Une équipe d'élite d'agents est chargée de protéger un dangereux baron de la drogue. Ils se réfugient dans un hôtel de luxe en attendant leur extraction. Ils se retrouvent bientôt au centre d'une embuscade alors que les anciens associés du baron de la drogue lancent un assaut explosif sur l'hôtel.

programme.title: Fight Girls
programme.desc: Un groupe de chanteuses punks est kidnappé dans un quartier sordide. A leur réveil, elles réalisent que certains de leurs membres ont été remplacés par des armes mortelles. Leur unique chance de survie est de s'affronter dans une arène pour divertir les membres d'une secte, assoiffés de sang.

programme.title: Miss Bala
programme.desc: Après la disparition de son amie à Tijuana, Gloria Meyer se retrouve au centre d'un jeu dangereux joué par la CIA, la DEA et un chef de gang.

programme.title: Under Siege
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un agent de la CIA renégat et ses mercenaires s'emparent d'un cuirassé américain pour récupérer ses ogives nucléaires, la seule personne à bord qui puisse sauver la mise est le chef cuisinier, qui se trouve être un ancien Navy SEAL.

programme.title: Close Range
programme.desc: Pour protéger sa famille, un soldat devenu hors-la-loi est entrainé dans un violent conflit avec un shérif corrompu, ses adjoints et un dangereux cartel de drogue.

programme.title: Demon City Shinjuku
programme.desc: Dix ans après qu'un sorcier maléfique, Rebi Ra, a transformé Shinjuku en une ville démoniaque, un jeune combattant nommé Kyoya est contraint d'affronter cet ennemi redoutable. Avec l'aide de Sayaka, la fille du président du monde libre, et d'étranges alliés rencontrés en chemin, il doit traverser les ruines infestées de créatures démoniaques pour empêcher Rebi Ra d'ouvrir un portail vers les enfers et de plonger le monde entier dans le chaos.

programme.title: L'Appel de la Chair
programme.desc: Jeune actrice de comédie musicale, Laura se désespère de sa situation : elle sort d'une opération liée à son cancer, doit retourner vivre dans la maison de son enfance, et son compagnon Jacob vient de la quitter. Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: Totem
programme.desc: Buffle, un ancien scout, n'a toujours pas fait le deuil de son ami disparu il y a vingt ans. En plus de cela, il est constamment hanté par un rat géant… Sa psychologue lui conseille de reformer sa bande en organisant un camp. Mais cette thérapie de groupe va prendre une nouvelle dimension lorsque que nos quadragénaires vont découvrir un passage temporel.

programme.title: La Mort Caresse à Minuit
programme.desc: Top model en vogue pour une agence italienne, Valentina essaie une toute nouvelle drogue proche du LSD. Au cours de sa traversée psychédélique, elle assiste à un meurtre d'une cruauté surprenante. Persuadée que cet assassinat n'est pas que le fruit de son imagination, elle se met en quête de l'assassin.

programme.title: L'Exorcisme de Tamara
programme.desc: Un cambriolage tourne à l'horreur dans une maison.

programme.title: Creuser pour Survivre
programme.desc: Un père et sa fille sourde sont forcés par des criminels de creuser sous une maison abandonnée.

programme.title: Haunted : L'enfant du Passé
programme.desc: Après la mort de son père, Catherine retourne dans son ancien domaine familial en Norvège.

programme.title: Last Survivors
programme.desc: Dans un monde apocalyptique, un jeune homme tombe amoureux d'une mystérieuse jeune femme, au grand désespoir de son père.

programme.title: 28 Jours plus tard
programme.desc: im, un coursier, se réveille du coma dans un hôpital londonien désert. Alors qu'il erre dans les rues sans vie de la ville, il découvre un groupe de survivants et apprend qu'un virus mortel semblable à la rage s'est propagé. Y a-t-il encore un espoir pour l'humanité ? Ou bien le virus s'est-il répandu sur toute la planète?

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: La mort inexpliquée d'un agent de la protection des eaux et forêts, déchiqueté avec férocité, plonge Black Lake dans la perplexité et la peur. Une équipe d'enquêteurs arrive sur place et découvre une dent datant de l'ère préhistorique. Le garde forestier Jack Wells, la paléontologue Kelly Scott, le shérif Hank Keough et le professeur Hector Cry vont devoir affronter un reptile de plus de dix mètres de long, véritable machine à broyer issue de l'espèce des crocodylus.

programme.title: The Walk
programme.desc: Douze personnes ont marché sur la lune. Un seul homme aura marché au-dessus du vide vertigineux séparant les deux tours du World Trade Center. programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: I Was Diagnosed With HIV At 17
programme.desc: Adrian Duggan was diagnosed with HIV at the age of 17 after going to the doctor for an STI test. Now 23, Adrian is a part of the 'You, Me and HIV' campaign. Launched in January of 2025, the campaign aims to tackle misconceptions surrounding a HIV diagnosis in order to help reduce the stigma experienced by people living with HIV across Ireland.

programme.title: FootballJOE Quiz
programme.desc: The FootballJOE Quiz returns for its 100th episode with original panelists Ben and Ibi. The episode focuses on century milestones with questions about goals, caps, and appearances, alongside new quiz rounds.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: Joe Pub Quiz with Eddie Hall & Expressions
programme.desc: Eddie Hall and Expressions take on a quiz about the Sidemen, Gen Z slang, old-school phrases, and iconic Sidemen quotes. From completely missing the mark to unexpectedly clutch answers, the episode is full of laughs as they attempt to decode Gen Z slang, test how well they know each other, and recall legendary Sidemen moments.

programme.title: Labour's Local Election Wipeout Analysed
programme.desc: Laura and Seán analyse the 2026 local elections, examining the winners and losers as Labour's poor form continues. Reform achieved significant gains with a landslide in councils across the country, whilst the Greens made notable wins in Hackney and Edinburgh. In Wales, Labour's First Minister failed to gain reelection as the party's troubles deepen. The question remains whether Keir Starmer can survive.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Do they know what a spicebag is? Can they tell the difference between real and fake Irish sayings? And can they identify some iconic Irish people?

programme.title: Taylor Lorenz Interview
programme.desc: Taylor Lorenz is the journalist mapping out the culture of the internet and everything surrounding it. She discusses the growing power of the right in the online world, their ever-tightening grip on regulations of the internet and speech in the digital space, and how to fight back against it.

programme.title: Why Politics Doesn't Work Anymore
programme.desc: Author and Academic Anton Jäger discusses his book Hyperpolitics, examining contemporary political participation and the challenges facing progressive movements. He explores the decline of traditional party politics, the shift towards hyperpolitics where people are engaged but unorganised, and why the right has been more successful in building institutions. Jäger outlines issues with social media activism and presents approaches to creating a more collectivised political movement capable of challenging right-wing advances.

programme.title: Palantir: The UK Government's Single Point Of Failure
programme.desc: Martin Wrigley is one of the few MPs who understands the threat of big tech. Earlier this year told us about the growing influence of AI firm Palantir across the British state, from the NHS and the Ministry of Defence to the Cabinet Office. Starting with an off-the-books meeting between Boris Johnson, Dominic Cummings, and Palantir co-founder Peter Thiel, Wrigley argues that the US tech giant has steadily embedded itself at the heart of government while remaining largely unscrutinised. Wrigley questions whether parliament even understands what Palantir's systems are doing. From data collection and technical lock-in to lobbying and corporate influence, he asks whether Britain's increasing dependence on a single American company might leave the country vulnerable.

programme.title: Alex Horne vs FootballJOE Quiz
programme.desc: Taskmaster and comedy legend Alex Horne takes on a quiz testing his knowledge of comedians, football, hams, chickens and more, filmed at the Chesham United clubhouse. programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: The Cliff Diver and The Egomaniac
programme.desc: The world-renowned matchmaker, Patti Stanger, is back and upping her matchmaking game! Along with her team of love gurus, Patti takes over the Luxe Hotel in Los Angeles where she will practice her toughest love yet to break the most challenging clients of their bad dating habits as they vie for true love. Checking into the Millionaire's Club for the week are two, polar opposite bachelors and best buds from The Bachelor: the cliff diver, Vinny Ventiera and the ultimate narcissist, Daniel Maguire. Unbeknownst to the millionaires, Patti's eyes and ears are everywhere! Before being fixed up, Daniel must go through one of Patti's love lessons to shock him out of his bad boy behavior. Daniel keeps his expectations high and his compliments low, but is blindsided when Patti gives him a shocking first impression rose! Meanwhile, Patti must get Vinny to learn how to ‘qualify his buyer' before cliff diving into the wrong relationship. Patti and her team of love experts recruit sexy singles for the bachelors but things turn left during the mingle when a fan girl leaves Vinny for Daniel! Though the millionaires get to choose who to take out, Patti decides to strategize a special date, specifically designed to break the bromance and spark romance. But when Patti's rules are broken, who will get the wrath of the no-nonsense matchmaker? In the end, will the daters accept Vinny and Daniel's final rose or will the bachelors check out heartbroken and alone?

programme.title: Devina A.D.D. & The Relationship Virgin
programme.desc: It's a new week at the Millionaire's Club and that means two tough new clients for matchmaker, Patti Stanger. Author Devina Kaur is a sex crazed dating addict who's obsessed with hooking up with men on Craigslist. And Peter Curti, a gay millennial entrepreneur with his head buried in his phone, has never had a real relationship. Devina proves to be a challenge right out of the gate, matching Patti scream for scream. All of her outbursts leave Patti wondering if Devina has come to the Millionaire's Club just because she's run out of men on the internet. And when Patti throws a test into the mingle, Devina A.D.D. unsurprisingly fails miserably and earns a matchmaker punishment. It's a crap-shoot whether this wild and crazy Canadian will finally listen to Patti and find true love or revert to searching Craigslist for men. Meanwhile, relationship virgin Peter, is thrown into his love lesson. When confronted with his anti-social behavior, he argues with Patti, even telling her she's too old to understand. A generation gap Is obvious but Patti knows that dealing with millennials and their tech obsession requires an adjustment in tactics. Peter needs to learn to ditch his phone, pull his eyes up and learn to approach men like an alpha or he'll end up alone!

programme.title: Mr. Build-A-Girl and The Basketball Wife
programme.desc: This week it's a full-on, knock-down, drag-out fight between Patti Stanger and her two combative clients! Tough girl Basketball Wives LA tv star, Laura Govan, was majorly burned by her NBA star boyfriend of 17 years. Their nasty and highly publicized breakup left Laura alone with their four kids and with major trust issues. Patti's hidden cameras catch Laura in the act of some shocking behaviors that Laura uses to keep men away from her heart. If Laura wants to find a good man and potential stepfather to her four kids, she has to change her offensive deflecting behavior, or she'll remain single. Meanwhile, Bastian Yotta is obsessed with working out, his good looks and wants a woman who is equally as “perfect”. Patti calls Bastian out for being a “build-a-girl” after discovering that he will do will do anything to improve a woman's looks, even suggest and pay for their surgical enhancements. His superficial mentality prevents chemistry from taking over and Patti is forced give him one of her toughest reality checks ever to try and shake him of his perfectionism. At the mingle, it's Patti vs Bastian in a heated altercation after he insults the looks of one of her daters. And Laura and Bastian's dates go off the rails when one goes for a colon cleanse and the other instigates a private bikini fashion show. Both clients get the wrath of Patti, but will that be enough to help them get on the right path to true love?

programme.title: The Ageist and The Snob
programme.desc: Third generation matchmaker Patti Stanger is back and better than ever! She's taken over the exclusive Luxe Hotel in Bel-Air where she brings her toughest clients for a week-long lesson in love. This week, Patti is on the case with two tough lawyers: the ageist, David Goldman, and the first-class snob, Rhonda Wills. Right out of the gate, David jumps head first into a love lesson that he fails miserably when he ditches his age-appropriate date for a romp in the pool with a bunch of 20-somethings. Meanwhile, Patti struggles to convince Snobby Pants Rhonda to give up on her fairytale fantasy of Prince Charming. Patti, Candace, and Maxwell team up to find the perfect sexy singles for the mingle, but Patti throws the ageist David another curve ball when she adds a 22-year-old to the mix to test him. Will he fall for it and break Patti's rules or has he learned his lesson? Rhonda, on the other hand, meets a knight in shining armor. But… will she try to escape when he fails to deliver a fairytale first date. In the end, Patti's got a tough week. Will the lawyers learn their lesson or will it be a hung jury?

programme.title: Little Lovebird & Mr. Know-It-All
programme.desc: This season, Patti Stanger faces the toughest of the tough cases and this week is no exception. Jersey native, Jason Karniol is a poker playing ticket broker who thinks he knows everything. He takes his poker skills into his dating life and actually reads women's “tells”, dismissing them immediately. He performs true-to-type during his love lesson and infuriates Patti by insisting his methods work. Yelling and insults start flying and Patti lays down the law. Jason must stop his ridiculous “Forget-About-It Frank” behavior and get to know women before judging them. But old habits die hard and Jason struggles to follow Patti's rules. Meanwhile, little person Kacy McInturff from “Little Weddings” fame has only known bootie call love her entire adult life. And no one has ever told her they love her… ever! At 39, she feels the clock is ticking and wedding planner, Kacy needs to decide if she'll follow Patti demands, no matter how painful, in order to change the course of her life. Kacy needs to learn how to demand monogamy in her relationship. But this little lovebird has a habit of returning to her old familiar nest regardless of how much she wants things to change. Even the world's best matchmaker might not be able to break these two of their bad habits and help them find true love.

programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E4
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E5
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Wonderful Wetlands
programme.desc: Water is the key to life. It provides a haven for countless plants and animals, everything from water-loving cats and predatory birds to killer dragonflies and carnivorous foliage. It can be a nursery, a migration stopover and a larder. And there's place where water is gathered, drained and stored for all to enjoy – the wetland. Wetlands are some of the most remarkable ecosystems in the natural world everything from dragonflies and bats to fish and amphibians can thrive thanks to the wonderful wetland.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth

From the playful antics of newborn calves through the haunting songs of adult males to the human impact on their habitats and lives – an inspiring journey.

We will also shed light on the importance of shark conservation and the urgent need to protect these apex predators from human threats.

programme.title: Cheetah: Beating the Odds
programme.desc: A cheetah raises her young family on the vast expanse of the Serengeti. If her cubs are going to survive, she'll have to overcome a barrage of challenges. Lions, gangsters of the plains, are quick to throw their muscle around, whilst hyenas and jackals attempt to steal anything the cheetah manage to kill. The cheetah will have to learn the hunting skills their mother has perfected. Once they've learnt the ropes, they'll make their own way across the plains, establishing territory and having cubs of their own.

programme.title: Seals

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters

programme.title: Mega Nature

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America's National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: Coasts
programme.desc: A cat shark out hunting, guillemots fearlessly jumping from the cliffs of Helgoland, the birth of a snow-white baby seal: the 2,400km of German coastlines are home to a unique diversity of species. Over thousands of years, the slow current of the North Sea has allowed silt to accumulate and form the unique world of the Wadden Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2009. Nowhere else in the world does such a landscape exist that, thanks to the tides, is in a constant state of change. On the Baltic Sea, it's above all the Bodden that are unique. They form a chain of shallow bodies of water connected to the sea by narrow channels. Here in the brackish water, only specialists can survive. The North Sea coast is famed for its extensive mud flats, the Halligen islands which are often submerged in winter and endless sandy beaches and dykes. Seals sun themselves on sandbanks and regenerate after the rigours of hunting. Plum in the middle of the North Sea, the cliffs of Helgoland are a paradise for seabirds like gannets, black-legged kittiwakes and guillemots. For the grey seals, the mating season begins in winter and with it fearsome battles between rival males. The largest bulls weigh in at 300kg and are the biggest mammals in Germany. Hunted mercilessly by fishermen competing for the same fish, for many years the seals had disappeared from Germany's coasts. Now they're under protection and are slowly returning. North and Baltic Seas have retained their original character. The Baltic has Darss, Rügen and Usedom, three of the most beautiful holiday destinations in the country and with the whitest beaches. In autumn, red deer stags stamp majestically along the sand against the foamy backdrop of the Baltic. Peregrine falcons, too, have made coast and islands their home.

programme.title: Wild Hungary
programme.desc: "Wild Hungary - A Water Wonderland" is a wildlife documentary about a white-tailed eagle family, a young otter and a giant catfish that share the wetlands of this country in Central Europe. Hungary lies in the bottom of the huge Pannonian Basin encircled by the peaks of the Alps and the Carpathians. Countless rivers and streams run from the mountains into the heart of the basin like the Danube or the Tisza and the countryside is densely scattered with thousands of lakes as well. In such a water paradise it's not surprising that wildlife is flourishing, often quite close to human settlements or well-known tourist destinations like the Lake Balaton or the Hungarian Puszta. "Wild Hungary" is also the story of a fisherman and a herdsman for whom the rhythm of the river and the moving of the water makes the yearly calendar. "Wild Hungary" offers a view behind the clichés that lives about this country. And there are much more to taste than the famous goulash soup.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Awakening
programme.desc: When Mateo's comic creation, Z-Blob, follows him from a dream back to Brooklyn, Mateo and his sister realize the Dream World is real, and in danger!

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: After a daring mission to save their friend in the Dream World, Mateo and Izzie find the nightmare has followed them back to the Waking World.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Spooky Sensation
programme.desc: The girls decided to spend a weekend at the hotel. It appears to be haunted. Watch the full video to know more about this.

programme.title: Sings of Love
programme.desc: See how Stephanie and Olivia enter the Under the Sea photo competition. Jacob wrote a love song! Olivia and her friends are very excited to hear. Tanya and Stephanie are teamed up in baking class. Watch the video for more fun.

programme.title: Video Wonder
programme.desc: Olivia and Andrea visited science camp with Mrs Stevens. On the other hand, Andrea and Mia decides to return a lost skunk to nature. Andrea was reading intimate postcards between Chef Pierre and Mrs. Stevens.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor

Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.
